Damien, saw Verse just shipped RCS messaging for branded business texting.

Rolling out a new channel usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before quota catches up, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Verse off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Damien, quick follow-up for Verse.

Inside a larger org post-acquisition, the revenue number tends to climb faster than headcount can. Most revenue leaders don't actually know how many booked meetings it takes to hit the target, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Verse needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Damien, last bit of proof for Verse.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Verse's reply rate likely compares to other conversational-AI teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
